title: Recording, editing: To You by Wings | 1978
content:
Spirit of Ranachan Studio, Low Ranachan Farm, Campbeltown, Scotland
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas
Engineers: Phil McDonald, Mark Vigars, Tim Summerhayes

Wings continued recording the song ‘To You’ for their seventh and final studio album Back To The Egg on 30 June 1978.

The backing track had Paul McCartney playing a Zemaitis acoustic bass guitar and guide vocals, Denny Laine and Laurence Juber on electric guitars, Linda McCartney on organ, and Steve Holley on drums.

The band filled two tape reels. Takes six and seven were considered best, and were edited together to create a master version. Paul then overdubbed lead vocals.
